Priya (PartnerEng): Heads-up — EdgeWave pushed firmware v3.2 and Partner Success reports spikes in hourly usage. They say report_id is now a UUID per upload instead of device_ts.
Rosa (Partner Success): EdgeWave confirms change: previously report_id=device_ts, now report_id=uuid per transmission. They did this to avoid collision on their end.
Ethan (SRE): That breaks our dedupe assumption. We need a short-term dedupe by payload hash or device+hour window.
Luca (Billing): Duplicates mean overbilling risk. Any sample counts?
Priya (PartnerEng): Sample (anonymized): `{"device_id":"edge-007","hour":"2025-06-11T11:00Z","usage":{"tokens":1200},"report_id":"uuid-aaaa"}` then same payload with `"report_id":"uuid-bbbb"`.
Ethan (SRE): Short-term: compute `payload_hash=sha1(json_bytes)` and upsert on (device_id, hour, payload_hash). Long-term ask them to add `observation_id` stable across retries.
metering-bot: ingestion-alert: repeated payloads from edge-007 between 2025-06-11T11:02 and 2025-06-11T11:06 (count=3).
Priya (PartnerEng): Proposed plan: 1) add dedupe logic behind `edgewave_dedupe` flag in adapter, 2) deploy to staging tonight, 3) shadow dedupe on prod for 24h, 4) run hourly recon job.
Ethan (SRE): I'll add metric `edgewave.dedupe.shadow_dropped_tokens` and Grafana panels for raw vs dedup counts.
Luca (Billing): For credits: propose auto-credit if dup_pct > 1% AND dup_tokens > 1000 for a customer-hour. Legal sign-off required for >10k tokens.
Rosa (Partner Success): EdgeWave agreed to pause firmware rollout for 6h and provide a test fleet pointing to staging.
Priya (PartnerEng): Action items: @Ethan implement patch + metric; @Luca finalize threshold and approval flow; @Rosa coordinate test fleet; I'll open adapter PR and schedule a verification call 07:30 UTC tomorrow.
Ethan (SRE): Rolling patch to staging now.
